title: Delta-Vega Hedging with Deep Reinforcement Learning: From Simulation to Reality
abstract: arXiv:2611.32790v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hedging an option portfolio with the underlying asset alone leaves the position exposed to changes in volatility, which can be managed by trading another derivative, at higher transaction costs. We propose a deep reinforcement learning approach to hedge both price and volatility risk under discrete-time trading and transaction costs, by trading the underlying asset and a second, longer-dated option. We train the agent with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) on synthetic data from a stochastic volatility model, and restrict its state to quantities observable in the market, so that the policy learned in simulation applies directly to market data. In simulation, we validate the policy against semi-analytical Delta and Delta-Vega hedging benchmarks. translated_title: 基于深度强化学习的Delta-Vega对冲：从仿真到现实
translated_abstract: 仅使用标的资产对期权组合进行对冲，会使头寸暴露于波动率变化的风险之中，这种风险可以通过交易另一种衍生品来管理，但交易成本更高。我们提出了一种深度强化学习方法，在离散时间交易和交易成本存在的条件下，通过交易标的资产和一份期限更长的期权，同时对冲价格风险和波动率风险。我们使用近端策略优化（PPO）算法，在随机波动率模型生成的合成数据上训练智能体，并将其状态限制为市场中可观测的量，从而使仿真中学到的策略可以直接应用于市场数据。在仿真中，我们对照半解析的Delta对冲和Delta-Vega对冲基准验证了该策略。在基准交易成本下，PPO在目标上与Delta-Vega对冲相当，而随着成本上升，其表现越来越优于Delta-Vega，且两种双工具策略始终优于单工具策略。
tldr: 提出一种基于PPO的深度强化学习方法，通过同时交易标的资产和更长期限的期权，在交易成本下同时对冲价格与波动率风险，且仿真中学到的策略因仅依赖市场可观测量而可直接应用于真实市场数据。
en_tdlr: A PPO-based deep reinforcement learning approach is proposed to hedge both price and volatility risk under transaction costs by trading the underlying asset and a longer-dated option, with the simulation-learned policy directly applicable to real market data since its state relies only on market-observable quantities.
